scope: Direct accepted pairs and bounded open questions, in both prompt directions. No transitive exclusions or title-only harmlessness inference.

directions.妥 prompt, 了 meaning option: The target's 'settled' can evoke completion of an affair, although 妥 stresses its quiet resolution.
directions.了 prompt, 妥 meaning option: The comparison's 'completion; settling' can overlap a settled affair, not every completion.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 了: complete, finish; Daijisen 妥: 事がおさまる.

directions.妥 prompt, 定 meaning option: 'Determine; settle' can be confused with a settled matter, though deciding is not the whole meaning of 妥.
directions.定 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can resemble a matter fixed or settled by decision.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 定: determine, fix, establish, decide; Daijisen 妥: 事がおさまる.

directions.妥 prompt, 済 meaning option: 'Settle; finish' can resemble a matter settled, not necessarily a debt or completed process.
directions.済 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can resemble something settled, though 済 includes completion and debt settlement.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 済: settle, finish; JMdict 2198630 sense 1: arranged, settled, completed.

directions.妥 prompt, 決 meaning option: A resolved affair and a decision's settled outcome overlap without equating a decision with suitability.
directions.決 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can resemble 決まる's settled outcome, not all decisions.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1591420 sense 1: 決まる be decided, settled, fixed; Daijisen 妥: 事がおさまる.

directions.妥 prompt, 寧 meaning option: 'Peaceful' overlaps the target's documented peace, not its every appropriateness sense.
directions.寧 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can evoke a peaceful settled condition, not politeness generally.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 妥: peace; 寧: peaceful, quiet, tranquility.

directions.妥 prompt, 応 meaning option: 'Respond; comply' includes a context-dependent suitability sense, although not every response is suitable.
directions.応 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' overlaps suiting circumstances, not the general action of responding.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1179830 sense 3 応じる: suit, match, be appropriate to circumstances; 1400840 sense 1 相応: suitable, appropriate.

directions.妥 prompt, 優 meaning option: 'Gentle; superior' overlaps gentleness only, not superiority.
directions.優 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' includes a gentle or peaceful association, not the full kindness/superiority range.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 妥: gentle; 優: tenderness, gentleness; JMdict 1539020 gentle.

directions.妥 prompt, 凪 meaning option: A lull can evoke 妥's peaceful, settled association, though 凪 specifically describes wind or sea.
directions.凪 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can evoke calm conditions but is not a weather term.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 妥: peace; 凪: lull, calm; JMdict 1459660: wind or sea become calm.

directions.妥 prompt, 治 meaning option: 'Govern; heal' also includes calming a dispute; that settled situation overlaps 妥, not government or medicine generally.
directions.治 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can describe a settled conflict, though 治 describes it calming or being brought under control.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1316820 senses 1–2: 治まる conflict calms, is settled or at peace; 1316830 sense 1: 治める settle a dispute.

directions.妥 prompt, 収 meaning option: 'Collect; store' also has a settled-dispute sense at 収まる; it is not generally appropriate or peaceful.
directions.収 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can describe the settled conflict, not every act of collecting.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1330490 sense 5 restricts settled conflict and calming to 収まる; Daijisen 妥: 事がおさまる.

directions.妥 prompt, 柔 meaning option: 'Soft; gentle' overlaps gentleness of manner, not softness in every material sense.
directions.柔 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' includes a gentle association, not all flexibility or physical softness.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 柔: gentleness; JMdict 1460730 and 1605630 sense 2: gentle or mild.

directions.妥 prompt, 軟 meaning option: 'Soft' includes a gentle or mild manner in the shared 軟らか spelling, not all physical softness.
directions.軟 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can evoke gentleness of manner, not soft materials or every softened attitude.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1460730 and 1605630 sense 2 have gentle/mild and no sense restriction excluding 軟 spelling; 1460740 sense 2 softening of attitude.

directions.妥 prompt, 快 meaning option: 'Pleasant; agreeable' in 快 means a pleasant feeling or comfort, while 妥's appropriate/satisfactory describes suitability or a matter settling; that topic alone does not establish an interchangeable cue.
directions.快 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' describes suitability or settling, not the pleasant, comfortable feeling of 快.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 快: cheerful, pleasant, agreeable, comfortable; JMdict 1408540 妥当: proper, appropriate, reasonable; JMdict 1199970 and 1200120: pleasant, comfortable.

directions.妥 prompt, 満 meaning option: 'Full; satisfy' and 満足 include satisfaction or adequacy, overlapping 妥's satisfactory sense rather than fullness generally.
directions.満 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can resemble satisfactory or adequate, but not every instance of fullness.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 妥: satisfactory; 満: satisfy; JMdict 1526860 sense 2: satisfactory, adequate, proper.

directions.妥 prompt, 合 meaning option: 'Fit; suit; join' overlaps suitability, not the separate joining sense.
directions.合 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' overlaps suiting or matching, not all meetings or joining.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 妥: appropriate; 合: fit, suit; JMdict 1284430 sense 2: fit, match, suit.

directions.妥 prompt, 整 meaning option: 'Organize; arrange' includes bringing an agreement to a harmonious or settled state, not every act of arranging.
directions.整 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can describe a settled agreement, not all preparation or organization.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1598800 senses 2 and 4: 整う harmonious; settled treaty or contract; 1376140 sense 4 整える settle a deal.

directions.妥 prompt, 円 meaning option: 'Yen; circle' has a documented additional calm/harmonious sense in 円い, overlapping peace rather than the ordinary currency or shape senses.
directions.円 prompt, 妥 meaning option: 'Appropriate; settled' can evoke the peaceful/harmonious sense, not a circle or yen.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1604230 sense 3: calm, peaceful, harmonious; it lists 円い and does not restrict that sense to a spelling. The card marks 円か/まどか as literary; JMdict 1175590 gives tranquil without a literary tag, and 1175600 marks 円やか as rare and usually kana. Neither word-level sense makes ordinary 円 'peace' in isolation.

directions.循 prompt, 則 meaning option: 'Rule; follow a model' shares following a rule or precedent, not the noun rule in every context.
directions.則 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' can describe following a rule or model, not every rule or circuit.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 則: follow, model after; JMdict 1404080 sense 1: 則る follow a rule, precedent or style; Daijisen 循: 決まったルールにしたがう.

directions.循 prompt, 倣 meaning option: 'Imitate; follow a model' overlaps following an example, but imitation is narrower than 循 generally.
directions.倣 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' can mean following a model, not necessarily copying its form.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1599680 sense 1: 倣う imitate, follow, copy, emulate; KANJIDIC2 循 follow.

directions.循 prompt, 準 meaning option: 'Standard; conform' can describe following a rule or standard, not the standard itself.
directions.準 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' can describe conformity with a rule, not proportionality generally.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1341510 sense 1: 準じる follow a rule or precedent, conform; KANJIDIC2 循 follow.

directions.循 prompt, 応 meaning option: 'Respond; comply' includes complying with a request or demand; this can resemble following a prescribed instruction, not every response.
directions.応 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' can be defensible for complying with an instruction, not every response or matching sense.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1179830 sense 2: 応じる comply with a request, meet a demand; Daijisen 循: follow a set rule.

directions.循 prompt, 転 meaning option: 'Turn; roll' overlaps going around in movement, but a turn need not form a circuit.
directions.転 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' can evoke going around, not every change or turn.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 転: revolve, turn around; Daijisen 循 sense 2: あちこちとめぐる.

directions.循 prompt, 律 meaning option: 'Law; rhythm' names regulation or rhythm; 循 follows a rule or course and the supplied 律する senses control or discipline rather than explicitly follow a rule.
directions.律 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' names an action or course; the evidence here does not establish it as the law or rhythm itself.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 律: rhythm, law, regulation, control; JMdict 2256610 律する: judge, control, discipline, regulate. Daijisen 循: follow a set rule.

directions.循 prompt, 規 meaning option: 'Standard; measure' is a standard or measuring, not itself following one.
directions.規 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' describes following, not a standard or the measurement itself.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 規: standard, measure; JMdict 1223021 規則: rule, regulation; Daijisen 循: follow a set rule.

directions.循 prompt, 法 meaning option: 'Method; law' names a rule rather than the act of following, but 法る is a documented spelling for following a rule, so the pair is guarded.
directions.法 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' can describe 法る following a rule or precedent, not a law or method in every sense.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 法: method, law, rule, model; JMdict 1404080 sense 1 lists 法る as a spelling of following a rule, precedent or style; Daijisen 循 follows a set rule. The noun law is not itself the action.

directions.循 prompt, 復 meaning option: 'Restore; return' is a return or restoration, not necessarily a repeated circuit; 往復 is a trip out and back, not a source claim that 復 itself means cycle.
directions.復 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' does not mean every return to an earlier state or a one-time restoration.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 復: restore, return, revert, resume; JMdict 2012980 復する return to original state; 1179760 往復 round trip.

directions.循 prompt, 再 meaning option: 'Again; repeat' overlaps recurrence in the explicitly taught repeating cycle, but an isolated repetition need not form a cycle.
directions.再 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' includes a recurring cycle, so an again/repeat cue is defensible for that bounded association, not for rule-following generally.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1292300 再び again, once more; 1292760 再三 repeatedly; 1341340 循環 cycle, loop.

directions.循 prompt, 丸 meaning option: 'Round; circle' is a shape; rolling an object into a round shape is not the same as following a course or sequence.
directions.丸 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' is a traversal or recurring sequence, not a circular shape or rolling something up.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 丸: round, roll up; JMdict 1216300 丸める make round, roll up; 1604230 丸い round.

directions.循 prompt, 円 meaning option: 'Yen; circle' names currency or shape, not traveling a course or recurring sequence.
directions.円 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' describes following or circulation, not the shape or currency itself.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 円: circle, yen, round; JMdict 1175570 円 circle/yen; 1604230 円い round.

directions.循 prompt, 通 meaning option: 'Pass through; commute' has a circulation sense at 通う; movement between points is not necessarily a cycle.
directions.通 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' can overlap blood or electricity circulating, not every passage or commute.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1432850 sense 3: 通う to circulate blood or electricity; 1341340 循環 circulation, cycle.

directions.循 prompt, 流 meaning option: 'Flow' includes circulation, e.g. a rumour spreading, a different referent from a physical closed loop.
directions.流 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' can evoke circulation, but circulation of a rumour need not be a repeated circuit.

evidence.specificSenses: JMdict 1552140 sense 4 流れる: spread, circulate a rumour; 1341340 循環 circulation, cycle.

directions.循 prompt, 続 meaning option: 'Continue; follow' includes coming after or succeeding in a series, overlapping sequence rather than every uninterrupted duration.
directions.続 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' includes sequence or succession, not every continuation.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 循: sequential, follow; JMdict 1405790 sense 5 続く: come after, follow, succeed; 1559610: succession, sequence.

directions.循 prompt, 経 meaning option: 'Pass through; elapse' can describe traversal or elapsed time without following a prescribed course or successive series.
directions.経 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' describes following a course or sequence; passing through or elapsing alone does not establish the same cue.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 経: pass through, expire; JMdict 1251110 経る: elapse, pass through, experience.

directions.循 prompt, 巻 meaning option: 'Scroll; roll up' describes winding something or a scroll, not following a course or repeated sequence.
directions.巻 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' is not in itself winding a material into a coil; moving around a path and winding around an object are related but distinct.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 巻: scroll, roll up, wind up, coil; JMdict 1211200 巻く: wind, coil, roll.

directions.循 prompt, 番 meaning option: 'Turn; number in a series' shares a sequential turn, not every watch, guard or number.
directions.番 prompt, 循 meaning option: 'Follow; cycle' includes succession in order; a turn in a series can be a defensible related cue, not necessarily a recurring loop.

evidence.specificSenses: KANJIDIC2 循 sequential; 番 turn, number in a series; JMdict 2022640 senses 1–2 番: number in a series, one's turn.

limits: These are bounded source-based judgments, not proof of semantic uniqueness in every custom pool.
Unopened screening leads remain unassessed; they are not harmlessness findings.
Original exclusions remain intact; complete original comparison records and card snapshots are preserved in this packet and the initial B119 packet.
A word-level sense does not imply the same word is interchangeable with a target or every meaning of its constituent character.
